# RUN_LOG — index + maintainer entries

**Students: do NOT edit this file.** Add your run entries as
`logs/runs/<term>-<github-handle>-<n>.md` using the entry template in
`recipes/_shared.md`. CI rejects PRs that modify this file. The index below
is rebuilt by the maintainer at integration time.

Lineage: this repository is the Fall 2026 fresh cut of
[the-reallocation-engine-summer-2026](https://github.com/nikbearbrown/the-reallocation-engine-summer-2026)
(full Summer history, PRs, and run log live there — see archive/).
